Validate JavaScriptConfig Injection\nAdded explicit null check for the `JavaScriptConfig` parameter in constructors:\n```java\nPreconditions.checkNotNull(config, \"JavaScriptConfig must not be null\");\n```\n\nThis ensures that the JavaScriptConfig must be properly injected by the framework and cannot be bypassed through deserialization tricks.\n\n## How the Vulnerability Was \"javascript\",\n          \"function\": \"function(){java.lang.Runtime.getRuntime().exec('malicious_command');}\",\n          \"\": {\n            \"enabled\": true\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\nThe empty key `\"\"` would be deserialized as an unknown property, potentially overriding the injected JavaScriptConfig to enable JavaScript execution even when disabled.\n\n##
